"\"Create a 3D/2.5D offline single-player MOBA game inspired by Dota 2, using an isometric top-down camera view.
1. Map @COMMENT_BODY@ Objective:
• Create a symmetrical square map divided diagonally by a river into two bases: Radiant (bottom-left) and Dire (top-right).
• Connect both bases with 3 lanes (Top, Mid, Bottom) and place a jungle area with neutral monsters between the lanes.
• Each lane must have 3 defensive towers per team.
• The main objective is to destroy the enemy's main building (Ancient) inside their base to win the game.
2. Player Controls @COMMENT_BODY@ Hero Mechanics:
• Movement: Point-and-click using the right mouse button (or virtual joystick if mobile).
• Combat: Auto-attack nearest enemy when in range, plus 4 active abilities (Q, W, E, and R for Ultimate) with cooldowns and mana costs.
• Progression: Heroes start at Level 1 and gain Experience (XP) and Gold by killing enemy units (last-hitting) and heroes. Max level is 25.
• Shop System: Include an in-game shop at the base where players can spend Gold to buy items that increase stats (Damage, Health, Armor, Movement Speed).
3. Creeps @COMMENT_BODY@ Towers:
• Spawn waves of melee and ranged AI minions (creeps) every 30 seconds from both bases that march down the 3 lanes and attack enemies.
• Towers automatically target and shoot the nearest enemy unit, prioritizing creeps over heroes unless an enemy hero attacks an allied hero.
4. Offline Bot AI Behavior:
• Populate the match with 9 AI bots (4 allies, 5 enemies) so it is a 5v5 match.
• Bot logic must include: laning (farming creeps), using abilities on enemy heroes, retreating to the base fountain to heal when HP drops below 25%, buying recommended items automatically when they have enough gold, and grouping up to push lanes in the late game.
5. UI @COMMENT_BODY@ Visuals:
• Use a clean fantasy art style.
• Display a HUD with: Hero HP/Mana bars, ability icons with cooldown timers, current Gold, a minimap in the bottom-left corner, and a scoreboard.\"

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
